subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) WS-BH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/657d94de4cb3a7535e557df9e763525e99852be9d0f2c5b513972229a687f396.png] 

Option 2) RN-WC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d9a9573927b1a4e6b70583efe3f843a833a61d3d0ee962a0e717bfe06a0d51.png] 

Option 3) FA-KQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b036769e973c449a19bd8d8dc528e7285c09d792680a6b5f12e85a2f6bad102.png] 

Option 4) XT-CI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525beedc5c60913284525e5e46f8099871d8e37487a6291878b33fb22dedfc52.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'FA-KQ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
